import sys,time,json,hashlib,shutil,os
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'tools/verification')
import verify_thermal_scale as scale
root=Path('outputs/native-flow/thermal-time');mesh=Path('outputs/native-flow/thermal-scale/qualification/n100/mesh/square.solver.cm2d').resolve()
base=Path('outputs/native-flow/pressure-fixed-point/thermal-scale/n100').resolve()
report={'baselineCommit':'ee0e2a6','mesh':str(mesh),'meshSha256':scale.native.sha256_file(mesh),'runs':[],'reusedFirstCase':str(base),'timeoutSeconds':180,'scope':'Same 10000-cell mesh, t=.01, nu=.1 D=.02 U=1, flow tolerance1e-10, relaxation.8; dt halving. Reuses audited ee0e2a6 dt=.005 case.','binarySha256':{p:scale.native.sha256_file(Path(p)) for p in ['build/cartmesh2d_flow_cli','build/cartmesh2d_transport_cli']}}
command=[sys.executable,'tools/verification/verify_thermal_time.py','--case',str(base/'thermal'),str(base/'flow')]
for dt,steps in [(.0025,4),(.00125,8)]:
 directory=root/f'steps{steps}';directory.mkdir()
 for mode in ['thermal','flow']:
  if shutil.disk_usage('.').free<1.5*1024**3:raise RuntimeError('disk floor')
  if mode=='thermal':cmd=['build/cartmesh2d_transport_cli','--mesh',str(mesh),'--output',str(directory/'thermal'),'--verification','thermal-vortex','--dt',str(dt),'--steps',str(steps),'--flow-nu','.1','--diffusivity','.02','--flow-convection','limited-linear','--convection','limited-linear','--pressure-preconditioner','aggregation','--flow-velocity-relaxation','.8','--flow-tolerance','1e-10']
  else:cmd=['build/cartmesh2d_flow_cli','--mesh',str(mesh),'--output',str(directory/'flow'),'--case','taylor-green','--time-step',str(dt),'--steps',str(steps),'--nu','.1','--speed','1','--tolerance','1e-10','--convection','limited-linear','--pressure-preconditioner','aggregation','--velocity-relaxation','.8','--profile']
  start=time.monotonic();r=scale.run_process_group(['/usr/bin/time','-l']+cmd,directory/mode,180);r['elapsedSeconds']=time.monotonic()-start;report['runs'].append(r);(root/'runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print(mode,steps,r['status'],r['elapsedSeconds'],flush=True)
  if r['returncode']!=0:raise RuntimeError('case failed')
 p=directory/'thermal.carrier.checkpoint';q=directory/'flow.checkpoint'
 if scale.native.sha256_file(p)==scale.native.sha256_file(q):
  temp=p.with_name(p.name+'.dedup');os.link(q,temp);os.replace(temp,p)
 command+=['--case',str(directory/'thermal'),str(directory/'flow')]
command+=['--output',str(root/'study.json')]
r=scale.run_process_group(command,root/'audit',120);report['audit']=r;(root/'runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2));print('audit',r['status'],flush=True)
